jobs.title: Product Management Intern, Agentic Integrations
jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

Every brand Attentive works with runs on a stack of marketing and commerce tools, and they expect Attentive to connect to all of them. Our Data Platform team is building toward a future where connecting to any system in a customer's Martech stack doesn't require a long roadmap or a long engineering queue. Instead, AI agents build integrations and ship them to production on demand.

As a Product Management Intern on the Data Integrations & Platform team, you'll help make that future real. You'll work on two connected problems. First, you’ll own the prioritization of which integrations we pursue and secures everything we need to build them: partner approvals, API and developer documentation, and sandbox environments. Second, you'll help design an autonomous agent that automates that pipeline, along with a context layer that becomes the source of truth for every integration we build, so each one is easy to support and improve over time.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. Your work will directly shape how quickly Attentive can say "yes" to a customer's integration request.

What You’ll Accomplish

- Build and prioritize a backlog of integration opportunities across the martech ecosystem, using customer demand, partner ecosystems, and strategic fit to decide what we pursue next.

- Own the partner acquisition workflow end to end: submitting to partner programs, tracking approvals, and managing the long lead times so that integrations are never blocked on access.

- Gather and organize the inputs our integration agents need to build: API documentation, developer resources, and test environments for each target system.

- Design and prototype an autonomous agent that automates partner onboarding and information gathering, working alongside engineers and AI tooling.

- Define the structure of a context layer that serves as the source of truth for every integration, capturing what we know about each partner's APIs, auth models, constraints, and environments, so integrations can be supported and upleveled over time.

- Measure what's working, such as time from request to access, backlog coverage, and agent success rate, and use it to improve the process and the agent.

Your Expertise

- Currently pursuing (or recently completed) a bachelor's or master's degree in business, computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field.

- Interest in product management, APIs, and the AI agent space, and curiosity about how software systems talk to each other.

- Comfort reading technical documentation and getting oriented in an unfamiliar API, even if you're not a full-time engineer.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools, whether through coursework, side projects, or prior internships. Building or prototyping anything with LLMs or agents is a plus.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through. This role involves managing many external processes with long timelines and keeping them all moving.

- Clear written communication and structured thinking. You can turn a messy, ambiguous problem into a plan others can act on.

You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

- This role will be paid at the rate of $30 per hour and is non-exempt

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

Attentive is building an industry-defining Marketing Agent: a unified, vertically integrated, autonomous system that builds on three years of advances to create a step change in performance for our customers.

This is a chance to define what an AI-first company looks like and change the trajectory of an industry. You will help decide what autonomous marketing should mean, build the product that makes it useful and trustworthy, and work with a stellar team to bring it to market to 1000’s of Attentive’s enterprise brands and leading companies in every vertical.

We are looking for a product leader with marketing, advertising, or ecommerce experience and AI/ML depth to turn our vision into a product that brands trust, use, and get measurable value from. You will own the product strategy and execution for the autonomous agent, working closely with engineering, research, design, machine learning, data science, GTM and our customers.

Unlike in other industries, an AI-native marketing solution does not need to simply create one deliverable – it needs to guide and operate a complete machine learning system that itself delivers 1:1 experiences at scale. You will oversee the building of that complete system.

You will co-own the revenue number for this product and partner closely with our CEO to make it a success.

What You’ll Accomplish

- Define the product thesis, strategy, and north-star outcomes for Attentive's autonomous Marketing Agent. Make clear what we are building, for whom, why it will win, and what we will deliberately not build.

- Work directly with customers and internal experts to understand how marketing decisions are made today, where automation can create leverage, and where the product must earn confidence before it acts.

- Turn an ambitious, ambiguous opportunity into a focused plan: customer problems, product principles, roadmap, sequencing, investment choices, and the decisions required to make progress.

- Own the end-to-end agent experience and operating loop - understanding a customer's business and goals, forming a plan, taking action, measuring results, learning, and improving

- Partner deeply with engineering and AI/ML teams on model strategy, data and feedback loops, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, and the platform foundations required to make the product real at scale.

- Establish a rigorous system for evaluating the agent. Define the metrics, experiments, and failure analysis that tell us how much and why it is genuinely improving customer outcomes.

- Lead across boundaries. Clarify ownership, resolve disagreements, surface risks early, and build alignment without waiting for someone else to solve the problem for you.

Your Expertise

- 10+ years in product management or a closely related product leadership role, including substantial ownership of AI/ML-powered products. We care more about the level and quality of your experience than an exact number of years.

- A senior product leader who has shipped consequential AI/ML products and can connect technical possibility to customer value and business outcomes.

- Experience leading 0-to-1 products in a setting where the right answer was not obvious and the path changed as you learned. Experience with agents, decision systems, or applied generative AI is especially relevant.

- Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with researchers and engineers on model behavior, evaluation, data quality, system architecture, tradeoffs, and failure modes.

- Strong product judgment: the ability to identify the highest-leverage problem, make hard tradeoffs, simplify complexity, and distinguish a real product insight from a compelling story.

- A demonstrated habit of using customer evidence, experiments, and honest metrics to make decisions. You are comfortable showing that something failed when that is what the data says.

- The ability to operate as the mini-GM of a product area: set direction, create clarity, communicate directly, and take responsibility for outcomes across functions.

You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

- The US base salary range for this full-time position is $281,600 - $352,000 annually   + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform Extensibility
jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

Attentive’s Data Platform collects and stores data on behalf of our brands across many verticals, from our roots in e-commerce to physical retail, sports, entertainment, travel, and hospitality. Retail brands with physical stores want product inventory modeled down to the store location. Multinational brands want product catalogs and their customers segregated by market. A sports franchise wants live events and ticketing data modeled so that marketing agents know the right time and context to personalize messaging for any customer.

All the data clients want to ingest into the Attentive platform is activated across our product surface areas, from our core SMS & email products to our next-generation suite of marketing agents.

As the Senior Product Manager, Data Platform Extensibility, you will own the evolution of the Attentive data model to support these use cases. Your mandate is to build the generic primitives that let Attentive model any customer's business in our platform. You will decide which data entities become first-class concepts in the platform and which stay flexible to meet other customer needs. This role requires deep technical fluency in data modeling to recognize patterns across seemingly disconnected use cases to identify solutions that can scale across a broad set of verticals that Attentive will expand rapidly into.

What You’ll Accomplish

- Introduce new first-class and generic data objects to the data platform, starting with the gaps slowing down enterprise deals today, and establish the paradigm that makes each subsequent object dramatically cheaper to add.

- Define how objects relate to one another — users to offers, events to catalogs, catalogs to stores and regions — unlocking use cases like bring-your-own product and offer recommendations that customers cannot express in the platform today.

- Build the semantic layer that tells marketers and agents what their data means, and decide what data gets promoted to native object entities

- Partner across product and engineering to ensure every new object and field is consistently exposed to segmentation, personalization, reporting, and our APIs and MCP surfaces — so both marketers and agents can reason over and act on it.

Your Expertise

- 4+ years of product management experience building complex B2B or SaaS platforms, with a track record of owning ambiguous, high-scope problem spaces end to end.

- Strong technical fluency with data models and schemas — you can go deep with engineers on storage, relationships, extensibility, and migration tradeoffs, and you understand how an API contract shapes what customers can and cannot do.

- Ability to translate abstract infrastructure investment into concrete customer outcomes and business impact that executives and sellers can act on.

- Comfort learning an unfamiliar industry quickly and modeling it accurately — you enjoy the work of understanding how a business actually operates before deciding how the platform should represent it.

- Exceptional written communication and structured thinking. Much of this role is defining strategy from a blank page and aligning teams around it.

You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

- The US base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $210,000 annually   + equity + benefits
